SOME EXPLANATION ON SOME VARIABLES:

Opp. Punching? = Punch strength

PunchType = direction/dodgeability of the punch (1= left dodge; 2= right dodge; 3= duck; 4= you can dodge it however you want. Numbers can be combined, so, for example, 12= left or right dodge; 23= right dodge or duck)

Opp. Away? = The state in which the opponent is. If he's far from you and can't be punched, set this variable to 1. Else, set it to 0.

Starget? = if you can get a star by countering the opponent. The first digit checks how you can get a star by punch height (U= high punch; D=belly punch; B= both); and the second digit checks how you can get a star by the direction of the punch (L= left punch; R= right punch; B=left/right punch). For example, "UL" means you can get a star by throwing a left highpunch, and "DB" means you can get a star by throwing a belly punch in any direction. If this variable is set to 0, you won't get a star in any way.
